tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /klu brgyad kyi cho ga la brten pa'i gdon 'grol bya tshul phan bde'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/mtshan tsam bzung bas klu nad ma lus pa/ /sel mdza
༄༅/ /klu brgyad kyi cho ga la brten pa'i gdon 'grol bya tshul phan bde'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/mtshan tsam bzung bas klu nad ma lus pa/ /sel mdza

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /klu brgyad kyi cho ga la brten pa'i gdon 'grol bya tshul

phan bde'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/ mtshan tsam bzung bas klu nad ma lus pa/ /sel mdzad klu dbang rgyal bo la btud nas/ /gdengs can dbang bo rnam brgyad mchod byed pa'i/ /cho ga mdor bsdus 'jug pa bde bar bri/ /de yang sa stegs sam shing stegs gru bzhi ba ji ltar 'tsham pa'i steng du/ dkyil 'khor pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad ba shar dkar/ lho ljang*/ nub dmar/ byang ser/ shar lhor dkar/ lho nub ljang*/ nub byang dmar/ byang shar ser/ lte ba ljang nag /shar gyi khams dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ rtsig pa sngo/ pha gu ser/ mda' yab dkar/ sgo bzhi'am gcig / 'dod skam dang dra ba dra byed dam yin kyang rung*/ de'i phyi rol tu mtsho dang chu mig /de phyir ne'u seng sngon po gru bzhir byas te bri zhing de yang rdul mtshon nam/ ras shog la'ang 'phrir rung mthar shing ba lu su lu/ shug pa/ stag ma/ glang ma/ lcag ma/ snyug ma/ dmar shad/ 'bras bu can gyi shing rnams mtho re'am/ gru gang re btsugs te/ dar sna tshogs dang*/ tshon skud dmar bo sogs kyis brgyan no/ /de nas gser skyem gyi chu dang bsres pa'i zan gyi gong bu mdun du bzhag ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ zan gong stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las a dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ klu chen spyan drangs nas de la thim/ de yongs su gyur ba las rin po che'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam / de las klu rnams bar du 'debs ba'am bzo/ klu rnams stod mi lta bu la smad sbrul mjug can/ lag pa thal mo sbyar ba/ sprul gyi gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa yab brgyad dam/ yab yum gang 'grig byas nas pad 'dab brgyad gyi steng dang*/ lta ེ bar phyag rdor gyi tsa ka li 'jug cing klu rnams kyang sngar ltar ma grub na tsa ka li rung bar sems shing*/ de yang ma grub na pad 'dab brgyad kyi dbus dang phyogs mtshams su duḥbris pa la tshom bu dkod par bya'o/ /sku ni phyag rdor gyi mdun du klu rgyal wa ru ṇa dkar po/

/shar du nor rgyas dkar po/ /lhor pad+ma/ nub tu 'jog po/ /byang du pad+ma chen po/ /shar lhor dung skyong*/ lho nub tu rigs ldan/ nub byang du mtha' yas/ /byang shar stobs rgyu ste sku mdog 'chad ba ltar dang*/ klu'i mdog dang 'god tshul la ni go rim mi 'dra ba gzhan yang yod do/ /shar gyi khyams la sprul brgyad/ lcong dang sbal ba brgyad lhor rtsang pa dang spre'u nub tu ba glang brgyad byang gi khyams su dgod/ /brgyad re ma grub na ci thub de dag gi 'khor du khyung dang gla ba dang*/ phag rma bya lta bu ma gtogs pa'i sems can gang 'grub dang*/ khyad par du chur gnas pa'i srog chags rnams byas te rgya mtshor 'god/ mthar ram/ mdun du dkar gsum/ mnga' gsum/ klu sman sna tshogs dang ba dkar dang ra dkar gyi 'o ma sogs dang*/ mchod gtor rnams ci 'byor bsham/ grub na shar du stag mgo dkar po shar lta/ lhor sprul mgo ser po nang lta / nub tu bya mgo dmar po phyir lta/ byang du phag mgo ljang khu nang lta bya bar bshad de/ de rnams kyi mgo can yin pa 'dra'o/ /bum rdzas klu sman dang ldan pa'i bum pa mgul 'ching sngon po can shugs pa sogs 'bras bu can gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa dang rma bya'i mdongs rnams sta gon bya'o/ /de nas skyabs sems sogs sngon du btang nas/ rang nyid spyan ras gzigs/ rta mgrin/ phyag rdor sogs lha gang yang rung ba'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa'i sgo nas byed par rung yang*/ 'dir phyag rdor la brten pa'i dbang du byas na/ / oṃ swa bhā was stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid dpal phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdibs mdzub mdzad pa/ zhal gdangs nas mche ba gtsigs shing*/

spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes shing*/ sprul dang rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sngon pos brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyi ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gsang ba'i bdag po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥspyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing*/ spyi bos nas dbang bskur/ lus gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po cha'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ /zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur/ oṃ argaṃ aḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ a lo ke/ ghan+dhai/ nai wi t+ye/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis slabs/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi sar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swāhā'i bar gyis mchod la/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa na/ / zhes pas bstod/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng las 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad kyi don byas phyogs bcu'i rgyal pa thams cad kyi mthu nus thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bkug nas sngags 'phreng la thim par gyur par bsams te oṃ badz+ra pa ṇi hūm̐/

zhes ci 'grub bzla/ mthar yig brgya brjod cing*/ mchod bstod bya ba'am ma yin yang rung ngo*// //mdun bskyed ni/ klu ma bskyed par spyan drangs nas bstim pa'i lugs snang ba ltar yang rung mod bskyed na legs shing de'i tshul ni/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong ba'i dang las rin po che las grub pa'i klu'i pho brang gru bzhi pa/ pha gu dang*/ rgya phib dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs bas spras shing*/ chu mtsho sogs kyis bskor ba/ de'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar dpal phyag na rdo rje'i mdun du phuḥyongs su gyur pa las klu rgyal wa ru ṇa dkar bo gtso bo la 'dud pa/ phyogs 'tshams su phuḥbargyad yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du nor rgyas dkar bo/ lhor pad+ma sngon po/ nub tu 'jog po dmar bo/ /byang du pad+ma chen po dkar ser/ shar lhor dung skyong dkar sngo/ lho nub tu rigs ldan sngo dmar/ nub byang du mtha' yas dmar ser/ byang shar du stobs rgyu ljang khu/ thams cad kyang stod mi la smad sprul mjug tu 'khyil pa/ phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas gtso bo la 'dud cing*/ sprul gyi gdengs ka bdun bdun dang ldan pa/ nor bu rin po ches dbu brgyan cing*/ dar gyi na bza' gsol ba/ de dag gi 'khor du klu dang sa bdag gi rigs sna tshogs pas bskor ba/ de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun phyag na rdo rje dang rgya mtsho chen po'i klong nas klu chen brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs/ /hūm̐ bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje dang*/ /nor rgyas dung skyong 'jog po sogs/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor bcas rnams/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis 'dir gshegs shing*/ /gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni/ /sa 'og mun pa ma lus 'joms mdzad cing*/ /bstan ya rab dga' mthu stob bsam mi khyab/

/klu rgyal 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /gzhan yang rgyal rigs rje rigs bram ze'i rigs/ / dmangs rigs gdol pa'i rigs la sogs pa yi/ /klu gnyan bdag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /mchod sbyin gnas 'dir myur du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ e h+ye hi badz+ra pa ṇi nā ga rā dza sa pā ri wa ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ kā ma la ya s+t+wāṃ/ de nas mchod pa bdag bskyed kyi mjug tu 'am/ 'dir byin gyis rlobs na/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod pa'i tshogs sa dang bar snang gi khyon thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ rgyas par na sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin brlab bya zhing*/ bsdu na/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba ta t+khaṃ uṅga te s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ de nas 'bul ba ni/ / gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas bzang bo'i mchod yon 'di/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje dang*/ /klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas klu yi gnod pa dang*/ /nad rnams thams cad zhi bar mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi nā ga rā dza sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha hūm̐ swāhā/ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ gzhan yang gzugs 'gros sna tshogs dang*/ /'bru sman dar dang rtsi shing sogs/ /'dod rgu'i yo byad ma lus dang*/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum bdud rtsi'i sman/ /klu rgyal= / bzhes nas= /nad rnams= /sbyin bdag 'khor bcas la gnod cing*/ /'tshe ba'i klu gnyan sa bdag la/ /klu sman rin chen klu gter dang*/ /'bru bcud dar zab tshon skud sogs/ /mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad 'bul/ /bzhes nas= / nad rnams=

/oṃ nā ga rā dzā sa pā ri wa ra pū dzi te hūm̐/ de nas/ gsang sngags rig sngags 'chang ba'i rje/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje dang*/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul stobs mnga' ba'i/ /klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ / zhes pa 'am/ rgyas par na/ klu rgyal chen po wa ru ṇa/ /sku mdog dkar po gangs ri bzhin/ /klu rnams kun la dbang bskyur ba/ /mthu stobs can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /klu rgyal chen po nor rgyas ni/ /sku mdog dkar po zla ba bzhin/ /klu rnams= /mthu stobs= /klu rgyal chen po pad+ma ni/ /sku mdog sngon po dbang sngon bzhin/ /klu= /mthu= /klu rgyal chen po 'jog po ni/ /sku mdog dmar po pad rag bzhin/ /klu= /mthu= / klu rgyal chen po pad+ma che/ /sku mdog dkar ser 'od zer 'phro/ /klu= /mthu= /klu rgyal chen po dung skyong ni/ /sku mdog dkar sngo gzi brjid can/ /klu= /mthu= klu rgyal chen po rigs ldan ni/ /sku mdog sngo dmar gzi brjid 'bar/ /klu= / mthu= /klu rgyal chen po mtha' yas ni/ /sku mdog dmar ser sna tshogs 'od/ / klu= /mthu= klu rgyal chen po stobs rgyu ni/ /sku mdog ljang sngon 'od zer 'bar/ /klu= /mthu= khyed rnams mchod cing bstod pa'i mthus/ /sbyin bdag mi nor 'khor bcas la/ /gnod pa'i sa bdag klu gnyan las/ /byung ba'i nad rnams zhi gyur cig/ de nas bzlas pa la sngags mi 'dra ba gzhan zhig kyang snang mod/ /'di ltar legs te/ badz+ra pa la ṇi ci 'grub dang*/ oṃ nā ga rā dzā wa ru ṇa ya phuḥswāhā/ oṃ nā ga rā dzā ba su ki ya phuḥswā hā/ oṃ nā ga rā dzā pad+ma ya phuḥswāhā/ oṃ nā ga rā dzā tak+ṣa kā ya phu:swā hā/ oṃ nā ga rā dzā ma hā pad+ma ya phuḥswā hā/ oṃ nā ga rā dzā shaṅkha pā la ya phuḥswāhā/ oṃ nā ga rā dzā ku li kā ya phuḥswāhā/ oṃ nā ga rā dzā ā nan+ta ya phuḥswāhā/ oṃ nā ga rā dzā ka rko ṭa ya phuḥswāhā/ zhes pa rnams ci 'grub bzlas nas yig brgya brjod

cig /mchod bstod bsdus pa bya'o/ /chu rgyun gyi klu gtor byed na/ lag pa g.yas kyi chu rgyun sbreng ba dang g.yon pas se gol gdab ste/ oṃ ba su ki maṃ swāhā/ zhes pa ci 'grub brjod/ /de nas gtor ma sa mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi nā ga rā dzā sa pā ri wa ra i maṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi lan gsum dang oṃ hi li hi li gruṃ phuḥswāhā/ lan gsum/ oṃ bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha phruṃ phuḥswāhā/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ / bcom ldan klu rgyal 'khor bcas kyis/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes te/ /rnal 'byor sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /klu yi gnod pa zhi bar mdzod/ / ces 'phrin las bcol ba/ de nas/ bum pa a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las bum pa'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i klu nad thams cad sel bar byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun tu gyur/ / klu sman dang thun mong du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ci 'grub dang*/ oṃ nā ga rā dze shwa ra anghi ṣ+ṭha na anghi ṣ+ṭhi te swāhā/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sing+ngha lo tsa ni sarba ar+tha sā dha ni swāhā/ rtsi sman bdud rtsir bsgyur bar byed pa'i sngags dang oṃ de bya a mṛ ta nan ta ra bhi sha ma ti bra tī ts+tsha ba sa nan na ma swāhā/ zhes pa dang grub pa na/ seṅge'i sgra'i gzungs ring dam/ oṃ āḥhrīḥsingha nā da hūm̐ phaṭa/ rnams ci 'grub bzla'o/ /sbyin bdag la gnod pa'i klu gnyan sa bdag yogs su spyan 'dren na de'i gzugs bcos la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros sbyin bdag mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la phan gnod byed pa'i sa bdag klu gnyan gyi rigs rnams spyan drangs mdun gyi gzugs 'gros dag dang dbyer med du gyur par

bsams la/ klu sman gzugs 'gros rnams la gtor te/ ru ru s+phu ru sogs brjod cing*/ / 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams/ /de dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ /bcom ldan sangs rgyas dug mi mnga'/ /sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo/ /'dod chags= /de dag= /bcom ldan dam chos= /dam chos= /'dod chags= /de dag= /bcom ldan dge 'dun= /dge 'dun= /sa ni dug gi ma yin te/ /sa ni dug gi pha yang yin/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di yi mthus/ /dug ni sa yi nang du song*/ /gang ba'i nang du dug song zhig /chu ni dug gi ma yin te/ /= =chu yi nang du song*/ /gsher ba'i nang du= /me ni= =me yi nang du song*/ /tsha ba'i nang = /rlung ni= =rlung gi nang du song*/ /g.yo ba'i nang du= /hūṃ nga ni phyag na rdo rje ste/ /gso byed bdud rtsi'i rgyun byin pas/ /sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad dang*/ khyad par sbyin bdag 'khor bcas la/ /gnod pa'i klu gnyan sa bdag gi /nad rnams thams cad zhi gyur cig /lus dbang skye mched rgyas gyur cig /tshe dpal bsod nams ldan gyur cig /bsam sbyor ngan pa zhi gyur cig /bcings pa khro la bsdams pa lhod/ /sbyin bdag nad las thar gyur cig /nā ga rā dza phuḥshan+ti ku ru ye swāhā/

rgyas par na bzang drug sman gyi nus pa yis/ /sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad kyi/ /nad rnams thams cad zhi gyur cig /rma bya'i sgro yi nus pa yis/ /grib dang skra byi sos gyur cig /phyag tshang ku ba'i bdud rtsi yis/ /mgo bo nyams pa sos= /rgya mtsho lbu ba'i= /klad pa nyams pa= /nor bu gzi yi= /mig 'bras= leb rgan dmar bo'i= /lce dbang= /pad+ma ge sar= /mgrin pa= /snying bo zho sha'i= /don snying= /mkhal ma zho sha'i= /mkhal ma= /gur gum dkar bo'i= /mgrin pa= /dbang bo lag pa'i= /lag pa= /chu srin sder mo'i= /rkang ba nyams= /dung dang mgron bu'i= /rus so= /mtshal chen dmar po'i= khrag ni= /tshon sku sna lnga'i= tshe srog= /spu shel rtse yi= /rtsa rnams= /ut+pal sngon po'i= kha tog= /rin chen sna lnga'i= /nor rdzas= /dkar gsum mngar gsum= kha tog nyams pa= /mdor na rtsi sman sna tshogs kyis/ /klu gnyan sa bdag thams cad la/ /gnod 'gal byas pa kun zhi ste/ /bde ba'i dpal dang ldan gyur cig / de dag lan gsum mam gcig kyang slar yang 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ / kye nga ni phyag na rdo rje ste/ nga yi bka' la mi nyan med/ gtso bo klu chen brgyad po dang*/ /rgyal rigs rje rigs dmangs rigs dang*/ /bram ze gdol ba'i rigs rnams dang*/ /sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad la/ /rnal 'byor sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyis/ /gnod 'gal spyi dang khyad par du/ /sa brkos brag gshigs chu dkrugs dang*/ /shing bcad thabs gshob bgyis pa yi/ /gnod pa thams cad sos gyur te/ /mthong dug la sogs dug rnams dang*/ /mdze 'bras shu ba phol mig sogs/ /gnod pa thams cad mi 'byung zhing*/ phan dang bde ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / nad pa yod na glud cig byas te mdun du bzhag la/ seng ge'i sgra'i gzungs dang*/ /rnam 'joms kyi gzungs ring thung gang rung brjod cing*/ bsrung bya'i sdig pa'ang sgrib thams cad shan+ting ku ru swāhā/ nad thams cad= rims= gdon= nyes par 'tshe ba=

dus ma yin par 'chi ba= 'khon= grib= byad dang byur= skal ba ngan pa= ltas dang mtshan ma ngan pa= mtshan ma nag me'i gdon= bdud kyi zhags pa= gshin rje'i pho nya= bgegs dang log 'dren= lo skeg zla skeg zhag skeg dus skeg= bkra mi shis pa thams cad shan+ting ku ru swāhā/ klu rgyal rigs las byung ba'i nad dang dug thams cad shan+ti ku ru ye swāhā/ rje rigs= bram ze'i rigs= dmangs rigs= gdol ba'i rigs= klu gnyan sa bdag thams cad las byung ba'i = swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum sogs bya/ skabs 'dir bden brjod byas nas khrus chu phyir 'dor ba'am/ rgyas par na byabs khrus kyi skabs ltar yang rung ngo*/ / rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje'i= 'gro ba= 'di la= rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swā tā/ bgegs gtor gtong bar 'dod na/ cha gsum nas 'byung ba'i bgegs gtor zur du gyur nas gtong*/ /de nas gshegs pa la ni/ kye klu rgyal 'khor bcas khyed rnams kyis/ /phog thug gnod gyur bzod bzhes las/ /rang rang so so'i gnas su gshegs/ /rgyal rigs shar dang rje rigs nub/ /bram ze lho dang dmangs rigs byang*/ /gdol ba'i rigs rnams mtshams su gshegs/ /sa chu shing dang rdo rnams la/ /gnas rnams de dang de ru gshegs/ /badz+ra muḥnā ga rā dzā sa pā ri wa ra gats+tsha swā hā/ de nas gzugs 'gros rnams snod zhig tu bsdus te gtsang sar bskyal ba dang*/ khyad bar klu gzugs rnams chu bo chen por skyel ba sogs bya ste/ bya khyi sogs kyis mi za bar bya'o/ /de nas shis pa brjod cing me tog gi char dbabs so/ /klu brgyad gyi cho ga la gten pa'i gdon 'grol byed tshul 'di yang*/ gnas brtan grags dpal 'byor gyis bskur ba'i ngor/ klu brgyad gyi cho ga'i rgyu dang rgya gzhung du ma nas bshad cing 'dir yang gzhan gyis mdzad pa'i cho ga sngon ma gnyis tsam mthong ba dag la brten pa yina'ang ma tshang ba sogs kyis 'jug pa mi bde bas/

paṇa chen dang rgyal dbang gis mdzad pa'i klu gtor sogs gzhung gzhan 'da' zhig dang yang bstun te/ shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis gzhan phan gyi bsam pas sbyar pa'o// //bkra shis// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/klu brgyad kyi cho ga la brten pa'i gdon 'grol bya tshul phan bde'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 344-- PAGE 345-- PAGE 335-
